opportunities.title: 🦀 [CONTRACT] Optimize Storage Layout & Decouple Large Payload Structs into Sub-Keys
opportunities.summary: ## Summary Currently, all task metadata, bytecode arguments, execution history, and state flags are packed into a single monolithic `Task` struct stored under a single `DataKey::Task(u64)`. ## Failure Mode & Production Risk Every read/write operation (even updating a simple execution counter or status enum) deserializes the entire payload bytes, hitting Soroban CPU and read-byte gas limits and driving up transaction costs. ## Required Implementation 1. Split `Task` storage into normalized keys: - `DataKey::TaskMeta(u64)`: Status, interval, next_run, owner, bounty. - `DataKey::TaskPayload(u64)`: Target contract, function symbol, arguments byte vector. - `DataKey::TaskStats(u64)`: Run count, failure count, last_execution_ledger. 2. Update execution routines to only load `TaskPayload` when dispatching the cross-contract call. ## Acceptance Criteria - [ ] Storage reads in `check_task_ready` consume <30% of previous CPU instructions. - [ ] Benchmarks showing significant gas reduction on task status updates.

opportunities.title: parse_duration drops the days (d) unit
opportunities.summary: ## Bug `parse_duration` silently drops the **days** (`d`) unit. The README lists `d` as a supported unit, but the parser ignores it and returns a wrong (too-small) result instead of raising or counting it. ### Reproduction ```python from duration_utils import parse_duration parse_duration("1d") # -> 0 (expected 86400) parse_duration("2d4h") # -> 14400 (expected 187200) ``` ### Expected `d` should be counted as 86400 seconds, so `parse_duration("1d") == 86400` and `parse_duration("2d4h") == 187200`. ### Notes The `d` character is already accepted by the token regex, so malformed-input detection still passes — the value is just never added. A fix should add the `d` unit and cover it with tests. /bounty $50
